note: Cross-surface FEATURE-INTENT registry. One row = one product feature, keyed by intent, not by spelling — the same feature legitimately carries different code names per surface (wire INGEST vs UI 장기대여; workspaceId that means creator workspace). Rationale and usage rules live in the sibling contracts/feature-map.md. Gate: scripts/verify-feature-map.py resolves each surface's repo as a sibling checkout (../<repo> relative to this repo; 'Agentlas-OS' is this repo itself), requires the file to exist and to contain the identifier verbatim (rename alarm, not semantics proof), and prints an honest SKIP when a sibling checkout is absent. 'kind' is one of code|endpoint|screen|method|table|wireId|gate (gate = a dedicated parity/spelling gate that already guards this feature; the map points at it so renaming the gate also alarms). 'identifier' must be the EXACT symbol/route/table/string as it exists in the file today. Alias status: wire-legacy (still on the wire, name is historical), retired (must not reappear in new copy), display (user-facing label, translated per surface).

intent.ko: 허브 에이전트 호출은 작업(work order) 1건당 RENT 크레딧을 매번 과금한다 — 24시간 자동 리스는 폐지(오너 결정 2026-08-18).
intent.en: Every Hub agent call bills RENT credits per work order, on every call; the 24-hour auto-lease is retired (owner decision 2026-08-18).

surfaces.meaning: Canonical price-kind table. RENT: per work order, recurring, ceiling 100 credits; the unit token stays the legacy literal WORK_ORDER_24H because clients parse it.
Charge path: every runtime call resolves priceKind RENT and commits the wallet charge + ledger payload in one transaction before the bundle is released.
Desktop mirror of the wire price-kind union RENT|INGEST|FORK.
Flash notice: per-work-order estimated cost shown for 8s before a paid auto-hire, suppressed only when every hub hire is rent-allowed or day-leased.
Terminal notice before public Hub calls: credits are consumed per work order, 0 while a day lease is active.
Mobile shows the per-call estimated credits next to the agent's source label.

aliases.name: WORK_ORDER_24H
aliases.note: RENT's unit token predates the auto-lease retirement; a charge no longer opens a 24h window.

aliases.name: 24시간 자동 리스
aliases.note: Retired 2026-08-18; must not reappear in new copy.

aliases.name: 빌리기 / Rent · 작업 1건당 / per work order

intent.ko: 선불 일 단위 장기대여 — 대여 기간 중 그 에이전트 호출은 0크레딧이며, 와이어 id INGEST는 레거시 표기다.
intent.en: Prepaid per-day long-term lease of one agent; calls cost 0 credits while active. The wire id INGEST is legacy spelling.

surfaces.meaning: Unit token for the INGEST price kind: one agent for one day, ceiling 2000 credits/day.
POST /api/account/agent-leases buys/extends a lease (priceKind INGEST via commitNetworkEconomyCharge); GET quotes/lists leases.
Web lease domain logic (per-day pricing and lease windows).
Web purchase entry point on marketplace/agent pages.
Desktop client of the agent-leases endpoints, with the lease cache the rent gate reads.
Desktop lease/extend dialog (일 단위 선불 대여).
Mobile price-setting copy for the per-day lease (1–2,000 credits/day).

aliases.name: INGEST
aliases.note: Wire price-kind id; kept because clients parse it. New copy must say 장기대여 / long-term lease.

aliases.name: 프로젝트 인제스트
aliases.note: Old product framing (project ingest). Still literally present in Agentlas-OS agentlas_cloud/pricing.py PRICE_LABELS — stale copy, do not propagate.

intent.ko: 포크 = 허브 에이전트 사본을 1회 구매해 내 워크스페이스 소유로 설치한다; 획득은 웹 단일 진입점이고 사본은 출처 계보(lineage)를 영구히 지닌다.
intent.en: A fork is a one-time purchase of a Hub agent copy installed into the buyer's workspace; acquisition is web-only, and the copy carries its origin lineage forever.

surfaces.meaning: The ONLY acquisition path (owner decision: one entry point so lineage cannot be forgotten). Charges priceKind FORK via commitNetworkEconomyCharge and stamps the origin at install time.
Web buy-a-copy button.
Lineage record: originPackageHash is load-bearing; originOwnerUserId makes forked self-calls detectable.
Desktop refusal: a folder carrying fork lineage cannot be published to the public Hub; saves carry the lineage forward.
Reads the local restore marker whose .fork field is the desktop-side source of the lineage refusals.

aliases.name: install
aliases.note: Web UI says install; the wire price kind is FORK, unit ONE_COPY.

intent.ko: 프로젝트별로 '이 Hub 에이전트를 고지 없이 작업당 자동 고용해도 된다'는 명시적 동의를 (projectId × slug)로 기록한다 — 행이 없으면 기본 OFF, 자동 고용 후보에서 제외.
intent.en: Per-project explicit consent (projectId × slug) that a Hub agent may be auto-hired per work order without a per-send notice; no row means OFF and the agent is excluded from auto-hire.

surfaces.meaning: SQLite table added in migration v97 (appended to the ladder end), PK (project_id, slug), allowed default 0.
Store module; slugs are lowercased so lookups match the lease cache. Explicit user calls (/hep-call, @mention) are NOT gated here.
Main-process gate: a Hub spec passes if rent-allowed in this project, day-leased, or explicitly named.
Composer filter: non-allowed hub agents are dropped from the auto-hire preview; cost notice suppressed only when every kept hub hire is allowed or leased.

intent.ko: 모든 MCP 호출의 최소 메타데이터 원장 — 크리에이터 수익배분과 공개 신뢰 랭킹의 근거이며, 자기호출은 랭킹에서 제외된다.
intent.en: Minimal-metadata ledger of every MCP call — the basis for creator revenue share and public trust rankings, with self-calls excluded from ranking.

surfaces.meaning: Mongo collection (store key invocationLedger), receiptId-keyed with an outbox retry so lost rows don't undercount creators.

FIELD MEANINGS — callerId: caller workspace identity ('mcp-anonymous' when unauthenticated). creatorId: agent creator's workspace. workspaceId: CURRENTLY ALSO the creator workspace, NOT the caller — writer quirk, see recordLedger. Readers must not treat workspaceId as the caller.
The writer: sets BOTH workspaceId and creatorId to profile.workspaceId (creator). This quirk is why the reader-side self-call rule uses one comparison only.
Consumer. Self-call exclusion is exactly callerId ≠ creatorId; the old second condition workspaceId ≠ creatorId was removed because the writer stores the same value in both.
Consumer, same self-call rule; non-public sourceScope fails closed out of public trust.

aliases.name: invocationLedger
aliases.note: In-code store key for the invocation_ledger collection.

intent.ko: 모바일에서 데스크탑 브리지를 통해 내 에이전트를 허브에 공개 발행하고 가격을 설정한다 — hub-publish-v1 호스트 능력이 있을 때만 제공한다.
intent.en: Mobile publishes the user's agent to the public Hub and sets prices through the desktop bridge — offered only when the host advertises the hub-publish-v1 capability.

surfaces.meaning: Bridge method (with cloud.setHubPrices) in the production allowlist; validators bound prices to RENT/INGEST/FORK.
Host-side handlers executing the publish and price patch with desktop authority.
Capability advertisement. Older Desktops advertise only cloud-agent-actions; Mobile must not offer publishing against them.
Contract doc: exactly 60 methods including 30 writes; Hub publish methods gated on hub-publish-v1. A pricing failure after a committed publish is never a failed publish.
Typed result models for the publish and price-set replies.

intent.ko: 두 계좌 크레딧 잔액 조회 — 구독 계좌(A) remainingCredits(사용 가능)와 렌트수익 계좌(B) earningsCredits(내 업로드가 벌어들인 몫), 전송은 B→A 한 방향.
intent.en: Two-account credit balance: subscription account (A) remainingCredits, spendable, and rental-earnings account (B) earningsCredits; transfers flow B→A only.

surfaces.meaning: GET /api/billing/credits — the single source every surface reads.
Desktop main-process reader (cached ~60s); the paywall and mobile projection both consume it.
Read-only bridge method exposing the balance to Mobile.
agentlas billing command; honest exit 1 on auth failure — never fakes a 0 balance.
Transport constant for the billing.credits RPC; client mirrors the 60s re-ask cadence.

intent.ko: 에이전트 빌드(/hep-build)의 프롬프트 본문은 OS 정본 하나이며, 데스크탑 Build GUI는 같은 바이트를 그대로 싣고 터미널은 설치된 hephaestus 바이너리로 패스스루한다 — 토씨 하나라도 다르면 안 된다(오너 규칙 2026-08-16).
intent.en: Agent build (/hep-build) has ONE canonical prompt body in OS; the Desktop Build GUI ships the same bytes verbatim and the terminal passes through to the installed hephaestus binary — not one word may differ (owner rule 2026-08-16).

surfaces.meaning: Canonical /hep-build command body every host renders from.
Vendored engine copy of the canonical body that composeBuilderPrompt actually reads at build time.
Desktop Build system-prompt composer; must embed each canonical source verbatim for all three modes.
Byte-parity gate (npm run parity:hep-build): builds the real Desktop prompt and asserts each canonical source appears verbatim; $ARGUMENTS is substituted, never deleted.
Terminal passthrough: resolves HEPHAESTUS_BIN → ~/.agentlas/runtime/current/bin/hephaestus and delegates, so the terminal never re-renders the body.

intent.ko: hep-* 명령 본문은 OS contracts/commands/*.body.md 가 유일 정본이고, 133개 별칭과 런타임별 포맷(9-10종)은 렌더 스크립트가 매니페스트에서 파생한다 — 손 사본은 곧 드리프트다(hep-* 10 런타임 드리프트 사고).
intent.en: hep-* command bodies have a single canonical source in OS contracts/commands/*.body.md; the 133 aliases and per-runtime formats are derived by render scripts from the manifest — any hand copy is drift (the hep-* ten-runtime drift incident).

surfaces.meaning: One of the 12 canonical bodies; the file set contracts/commands/*.body.md is the whole universe.
Renders each canonical body into every host command format; true host differences are file format and args token only.
Renders the alias redirect files across runtimes from the manifest; aliases never carry their own body.
Generator config: canonical verbs plus runtime targets; derives everything else live from the sibling canonical hep-<verb> file.
Contract gate over the rendered command surface.
Vendored engine copy of the canonical bodies shipped inside Desktop.
Terminal command catalog listing the hep-* aliases it exposes; names must track the canonical verbs.

intent.ko: 에이전트 폴더를 클라우드/허브에 올리는 발행 파이프라인 — 패키징·검토·등록(registered upload)은 어느 표면에서 시작해도 같은 등록 규약(packageHash 기준 판정, registry 슬러그 ≠ 발행 신원)을 지켜야 한다.
intent.en: The publish pipeline that uploads an agent folder to Cloud/Hub — packaging, review, and registered upload must honor the same registration contract from every surface (verdicts key on packageHash; a local registry slug is not a publishing identity).

surfaces.meaning: OS/CLI publisher (hep-upload path).
Desktop packaging + review entry; also enforces the fork-lineage publish refusal (see featureId fork).
Maps local registry slugs to publishing identities — the 409 incident: firm-local-… slugs must never be sent as cloud identity.
Hub registration endpoint; duplicate/lineage verdicts key on packageHash, not scope. AgentDefinition (pricing/settlement key) exists only after this succeeds.

features.note: Mobile's surface of this feature is registered under featureId mobile-hub-publish (agents.cloudPublishHub via the desktop bridge) — cross-link, intentionally not duplicated here.

intent.ko: 워크포스 편성 3단계 규약 — 호스트 LLM이 redacted work order로 search_candidates → validate_selection → prepare_execution 을 밟고, 런타임 번들 문서 하나를 웹(발행자)·OS·터미널(독자 둘)이 같은 필드 철자로 읽는다.
intent.en: The three-step workforce staffing contract — the host LLM walks search_candidates → validate_selection → prepare_execution with a redacted work order, and ONE runtime-bundle document is written by Web and read by OS and Terminal with identical field spellings.

surfaces.meaning: Canonical redacted work-order schema every discovery call sends.
OS reader of the runtime bundle (pip/runtime-update cadence); fails CLOSED on unknown permission fields — the 2026-07-27 P0.
Web MCP workforce tool definitions (search/validate/prepare).
The emitter of the runtime-bundle document; deploys on merge, days ahead of both readers.
Desktop federation orchestrator: source pins, canonical_identity_no_rerank, Local>Cloud>Hub shadowing.
Runtime-bundle contract parity gate across the one emitter and two readers.
Terminal reader/driver of the same staffing wire contract (npm, user-paced cadence).

intent.ko: 워커 메모리 지시문은 system-agents/worker-memory-protocol.md 의 fenced block 이 정본이며, OS runtime.py 와 웹 runtime-bundle.ts 의 WORKER_MEMORY_DIRECTIVE 는 그와 바이트 동일해야 한다.
intent.en: The worker memory directive's canonical text is the fenced block in system-agents/worker-memory-protocol.md; WORKER_MEMORY_DIRECTIVE in OS runtime.py and web runtime-bundle.ts must stay byte-identical to it.

surfaces.meaning: Canonical protocol document; the fenced block is the directive text.
OS copy injected into worker prompts; skipped when the bundle already carries pm/learnings.
Web copy compiled into runtime bundles; same pm/learnings suppression rule.
Byte-parity gate across the canonical block and both copies (the gate whose false SKIP once hid real drift — gate scripts live inside the repo).

intent.ko: 에이전트 답변 속 제어블록(<<agentlas-ask>> 등)을 표시 전에 벗기는 규칙은 와이어 포맷 계약이다 — 데스크탑·모바일은 공유 픽스처에 대해 바이트 동일 출력을 내야 하고, 터미널은 데스크탑 공유 모듈을 재사용한다.
intent.en: Stripping agent control blocks (<<agentlas-ask>> etc.) before display is a wire-format contract — Desktop and Mobile must produce byte-identical output over the shared fixtures, and the terminal reuses the Desktop shared module.

surfaces.meaning: Canonical TS implementation (also defines the block markers).
Dart mirror; must match Desktop byte-for-byte on every fixture case.
Shared fixture file owned by neither surface — change only when the wire format itself changes.
Desktop-side parity gate over the shared fixtures.
Mobile-side parity test over the same fixtures.
Terminal display strip; wraps the shared module rather than re-implementing (three hand-rolled strippers was the defect).
Loader that gives the terminal the compiled Desktop shared module.

intent.ko: 도구 접근 고지문(어느 도구가 왜 열리는지)은 데스크탑 정본 빌더와 터미널 미러가 같은 입력에 같은 문장을 내야 한다.
intent.en: The tool-access notice (which tools open and why) must come out identical from the Desktop canonical builder and the terminal mirror for the same input.

surfaces.meaning: Canonical notice builder.
Terminal mirror of the builder.
Parity test comparing canonical vs mirror output (local-only: tests are gitignored in this repo).

intent.ko: 모델·워크로드 배분 결정(tier/effort/phase)은 OS 파이썬 정본, 데스크탑 TS, 터미널 CJS 세 벌로 존재한다 — 현재 3-way 드리프트가 알려진 부채다.
intent.en: Model/workload allocation decisions (tier/effort/phase) exist in three copies — OS Python canonical, Desktop TS, terminal CJS — with a KNOWN three-way drift carried as debt.

surfaces.meaning: Canonical decision schema + tier/effort/phase vocabularies.
Desktop resolver across runtimes.
Terminal normalizer of the same allocation payloads.

features.note: KNOWN DEBT (registered 2026-08-18): the three implementations have drifted from each other; no parity gate exists yet. This row carries the debt so the drift is at least rename-alarmed until a real sync gate lands.

intent.ko: 런타임 종류(claude/codex/…)와 백엔드 어휘의 정본은 하나여야 한다 — OS 라우팅 어휘·런타임 레지스트리, 데스크탑 shared 유니온, 터미널 kinds 스펙이 같은 구성원을 가져야 하며, 유니온에 멤버를 더하면 손 허용목록 전수를 쓸어야 한다.
intent.en: Runtime kinds (claude/codex/…) and backend vocabularies must share one canon — OS routing vocabulary + runtime registry, Desktop shared unions, and terminal kind specs must carry the same members; adding a member means sweeping every hand allowlist.

surfaces.meaning: Desktop canonical kind array (satisfies-checked).
Desktop canonical backend array.
Terminal kind specs (kind, bin, driver native|acp, capture).
OS canonical runtime tuple + alias normalisation.
Declarative runtime x model matrix seed (live rows merge over it).

intent.ko: ACP(에이전트 클라이언트 프로토콜) 러너 — cursor/grok/kimi 등의 실행은 데스크탑 acp.ts 를 지나며, 터미널은 같은 컴파일된 러너를 vendored core 로 로드한다. 대상 선정은 이름·타입이 아니라 행동으로.
intent.en: The ACP (agent client protocol) runner — cursor/grok/kimi executions pass through Desktop acp.ts, and the terminal loads the same compiled runner via the vendored core. Targets are picked by behavior, not by name/type.

surfaces.meaning: Runner + agent specs; the path all ACP-kind executions actually take (fix-lived-on-a-path-not-taken incident).
Protocol layer (stdio JSON-RPC, auth method choice, model options).
Terminal driver delegating to the vendored Desktop ACP runtime.
Loader that reuses the compiled Desktop ACP runtime instead of re-implementing it (SPEC T-08 refuted: vendored runtime is not dead code).
Contract test against a real fake ACP agent subprocess (local-only: scripts/test-*.cjs is gitignored in this repo).

intent.ko: 모바일↔데스크탑 브리지 프로토콜 v1 — 정확히 60개 메서드(쓰기 30개)가 정본이며, 데스크탑 allowlist·서버와 모바일 transport·PROTOCOL.md 가 같은 메서드 집합을 가져야 한다.
intent.en: The mobile↔desktop bridge protocol v1 — exactly 60 methods (30 writes) form the contract; the Desktop allowlist/server and the Mobile transport/PROTOCOL.md must carry the same method set.

surfaces.meaning: Canonical method allowlist + write set + event names; dependency-free so mobile tooling can parse it.
Host-side bridge server enforcing the allowlist.
Mobile transport's method constants mirroring the contract.
Human contract doc pinning the 60/30 counts and capability gating.
Parity test: mobile constants == desktop v1 method/write sets (60/30).

features.note: featureId mobile-hub-publish registers the hub-publish subset of this contract (capability hub-publish-v1); this row owns the method-set parity itself.

intent.ko: 허브 북마크 — 웹 계정의 에이전트 북마크를 데스크탑이 동기화해 로컬 호출 가능 목록으로 쓰고, 모바일에는 브리지 메서드 hub.borrowable.list 로 투영된다(모바일 이름은 borrowable).
intent.en: Hub bookmarks — Desktop syncs the web account's agent bookmarks into the local callable set, and Mobile sees them through the bridge method hub.borrowable.list (mobile-side name: borrowable).

surfaces.meaning: Desktop sync engine against /api/agent-cloud/bookmarks; fails closed on auth loss.
Web bookmarks API (list/add; [slug] route deletes).
Projects the bookmark set into the mobile borrowable list.
Mobile bridge method reading the projected list.
Contract doc row for the same method.

aliases.name: borrowable
aliases.note: Mobile-facing name for bookmark-callable hub agents; the desktop/web feature is 'bookmarks'.

intent.ko: 터미널의 무거운 기능(그래프 실행 등)은 재구현이 아니라 데스크탑의 컴파일된 코어를 정적 require 그래프 순회로 통째로 vendored 해 재사용한다 — npm install -g agentlas 만으로 데스크탑 없이 돈다.
intent.en: The terminal's heavy features (graph runs etc.) REUSE Desktop's compiled core, vendored wholesale via static require-graph traversal — npm install -g agentlas works with no Desktop app installed.

surfaces.meaning: The vendoring script: static require-graph traversal from run-graph.js (no hand-picked partial closures, no whole-dist copies).
Provenance receipt: source desktop root, root entry, file count, external deps.
Runtime loader resolving the vendored (or live sibling) Desktop core.
Source of the vendored closure's root entry (compiled to dist/electron/workflow/run-graph.js).

intent.ko: 그래프 자동화 — 실행 엔진은 데스크탑 run-graph 하나이고, 그래프 어휘는 shared/graph-registry/*.json 정본에서 데스크탑 TS·터미널 CJS 로 생성된다(손 사본 금지). 터미널은 sync:architecture 로 뒤따라온다.
intent.en: Graph automation — the one execution engine is Desktop run-graph, and the graph vocabulary is GENERATED from shared/graph-registry/*.json into Desktop TS and terminal CJS (no hand copies). The terminal catches up via sync:architecture.

surfaces.meaning: The single graph execution engine (checkpoints, loops, workforce prepare receipts).
Generated vocabulary; canonical data is shared/graph-registry/*.json via gen-graph-registry.cjs --check.
Terminal generated mirror; unknown values demote that entry only, never the run.
Sync script pulling the desktop-compiled architecture data into the terminal package.
npm script wiring for that sync.

intent.ko: 메모리 큐레이터의 판정값(승급·강등·admission 규칙 데이터)은 curator-ruleset.json 한 벌이 정본이며, 데스크탑 curator.ts 와 OS one_workspace.py 등 모든 실행기는 값을 여기서 로드한다 — 실행기에 판정값을 하드코딩하면 결함이다.
intent.en: The Memory Curator's judgment values (promotion/demotion/admission rule data) have ONE canonical file, curator-ruleset.json; every executor (Desktop curator.ts, OS one_workspace.py, …) loads values from it — hard-coding a judgment value in an executor is a defect.

surfaces.meaning: Canonical ruleset (rulesetVersion pins the revision).
OS executor; loads judgment values from the canonical ruleset (they had drifted before 2026-08-12 set 3 F3).
Desktop copy shipped with the app; must track the canonical rulesetVersion.
Desktop executor reading the ruleset instead of inline constants.
Vendored engine copy inside Desktop (release payload path — the half-repaired set3→set4 incident).

features.note: Distribution reminder: reaching the installed runtime requires BOTH the release allowlist and the installer copy step; a repo-only fix silently falls back to embedded values on updated machines.
